newsitem.title: USA: US senators offer country of origin bill for food.
newsitem.headline: US senators offer country of origin bill for food.

text.p: Legislation that would require supermarket produce to be labeled with the country of origin was introduced Tuesday by Idaho Sen. Larry Craig and Fla. Sen. Bob Graham.

"Pick up almost anything in your local supermarket or department store and you're likely to see its country of origin clearly displayed," said Craig, a Republican. "That same policy should also apply to the fruits and vegetables consumers buy in supermarkets."
The United States imports about $1.7 billion worth of fruit and vegetables annually.
The bill was co-sponsored by Graham, a Democrat.
